description: This file defines functions related to processing project manifests and converting project names into a map of project types, distinguishing between common and upstream/downstream projects.

methods.name: ProjectNamesToType
methods.description: Converts a manifest file group into a map of project names to project types, classifying projects as global or differential-specific.

methods.name: extractProjectNames
methods.description: Extracts project names from a given manifest file.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Creates a map from project names to their types based on whether they are common or distinct.
